note: Sizes are approximate. At download time ISHA asks Hugging Face for each file's exact size and SHA-256 (LFS oid) and verifies against it. Pin 'sha256' here to require a specific file. Maintainers can edit this file (or ship models_manifest.local.json) without touching installer code.
